headlines.description: Matt Prater kicked a 40-yard field goal as time expired after Darius Slay returned an interception 13 yards with 30 seconds left, lifting the Lions to a 16-13 win over the Vikings on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat Vikings 16-13, have sole possession of 1st place

headlines.description: Dak Prescott accounted for two touchdowns, fellow rookie Ezekiel Elliott ran for a pair of scores and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Washington Redskins 31-26 for their 10th straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookies lead Cowboys to 10th straight, 31-26 over Redskins

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger and Antonio Brown hooked up for three touchdowns Thursday night and the Pittsburgh Steelers' defense shut down the Indianapolis Colts in a 28-7 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown scores 3 TDs for Steelers in 28-7 win over Colts

headlines.description: Taylor Gabriel took two short passes for touchdowns and the Atlanta Falcons returned from a bye week to add to Arizona's misery, blowing out the Cardinals 38-19 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Speedy Taylor Gabriel leads Falcons past Cardinals 38-19

headlines.description: LeSean McCoy scored twice, including a career-best 75-yard run, and the Buffalo Bills won their second in a row by beating the Jacksonville Jaguars 28-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCoy rallies Bills to 28-21 win over Jaguars

headlines.description: Marcus Mariota threw for 226 yards and two touchdowns, and the Tennessee Titans hung on to beat the depleted Chicago Bears 27-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota throws for 2 TDs, Titans hang on to beat Bears 27-21

events.name: New York Giants at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Eli Manning threw two TD passes to Odell Beckham Jr., Jason Pierre-Paul returned a fumble for a TD, and the New York Giants extended their winning streak to six games, holding off Cleveland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Giants down Browns 27-13 for 6th straight win

headlines.description: Ndamukong Suh tackled Colin Kaepernick 2 yards short of the goal line as time ran out, and the Miami Dolphins handed the San Francisco 49ers a franchise-record 10th consecutive loss, 31-24.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick stopped at 2 as Dolphins beat 49ers 31-24

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 310 yards and four touchdowns, Mark Ingram scored twice, and the New Orleans Saints defeated the Los Angeles Rams, 49-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Ingram, help Saints rout Rams, 49-21

headlines.description: Justin Tucker kicked four field goals and Baltimore shut down the Cincinnati Bengals' depleted offense Sunday in a 19-14 victory that thrust the Ravens into a first-place tie in the AFC North.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens beat Bengals 19-14 to earn 1st-place tie in AFC North

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw for 242 yards and three touchdowns to give the San Diego Chargers a 21-13 win over the mistake-prone Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers tosses 3 TDs to help Chargers over Texans 21-13

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw a pair of touchdown passes to Mike Evans and Tampa Bay's rejuvenated defense shut down Russell Wilson and Seattle's sputtering offense to beat the first-place Seahawks 14-5 o
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston, defense led Buccaneers over Seahawks 14-5

headlines.description: Derek Carr came back from an injured pinky to lead another fourth-quarter comeback and the Oakland Raiders won their fifth straight game, beating the Carolina Panthers 35-32 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr overcomes injury to rally Raiders past Panthers 35-32

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Jets

headlines.description: Tom Brady tied Peyton Manning with his 200th win, throwing a go-ahead 8-yard touchdown pass to Malcolm Mitchell with 1:56 left to lead the Patriots to a 22-17 victory over the Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady ties Manning with 200th win, Patriots beat Jets 22-17

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Cairo Santos' 34-yard field goal hit the left upright and bounced through as the expired Sunday night to give the Kansas Chiefs a 30-27 victory over the Denver Broncos on Sunday night.

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw two touchdown passes to Davante Adams and the Green Bay Packers beat the Philadelphia Eagles 27-13 Monday night to snap a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers tosses 2 TDs, Packers beat Eagles 27-13
